info.name: FitLife — Workout logs (Run all)
info.description: Run all 4 requests in order with an existing, active user-role Bearer token supplied as the local environment variable token. baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:5000. Each run creates one workout log and may grant the first daily workout quest reward (10 coins) and daily water bonus (350 ml). The second POST reuses the run-local workoutId and must not duplicate the log or reward. No account is created and no credentials are included in this file. Send either GET request alone for read-only access; assertions depending on this run's workoutId are skipped when it is absent. See workouts.md.

exec: pm.test('Workout created without replay', () => { pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.eql(false); });

pm.test('Saved workout matches the submitted data', () => { pm.expect(b.log.workout_id).to.eql(pm.variables.get('workoutId')); pm.expect(b.log.title).to.eql('Hít đất'); pm.expect(b.log.category).to.eql('fullbody'); pm.expect(b.log.duration_seconds).to.eql(600); pm.expect(b.log.calories_burned).to.eql(50); pm.expect(b.log).not.to.have.property('_id'); });
pm.test('Workout reward is zero or ten coins', () => pm.expect(b.reward_coins).to.be.oneOf([0, 10]));
pm.test('Workout day water target is within the schema limit', () => { pm.expect(Number.isInteger(b.target_water)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.target_water).to.be.within(350, 4350); });
pm.test('Replay succeeds without creating another workout', () => { pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Replay returns the original workout ID', () => pm.expect(b.log.workout_id).to.eql(pm.variables.get('workoutId')));
if (workoutId) pm.test('Created workout occurs exactly once in today’s list', () => pm.expect(b.logs.filter(log => log.workout_id === workoutId)).to.have.lengthOf(1));

pm.test('Daily workout totals are nonnegative integers', () => { pm.expect(Number.isInteger(b.total_duration_seconds)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.total_duration_seconds).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(Number.isInteger(b.total_calories_burned)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.total_calories_burned).to.be.at.least(0); });

if (pm.variables.get('workoutId')) pm.test('Workout quest is completed', () => { pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); const quest = b.quests.find(q => q.quest_key === 'q_workout'); pm.expect(quest).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(quest.is_completed).to.eql(true); });
